### 0.1606.0

**Advancement fix**

A hidden advancement that some players had earned was not unlocking. It does now.

Each Community Reward now starts at its own amount and only goes up while another reward that costs more to run alongside it is on, so whichever is given first is the smaller gift. A grey line on the card says which reward is raising it.

- Two Streams now starts at $100 AUD.

**Send a lag report from chat**

If the game freezes for a few seconds, a line in chat offers to send your log to the developer so the freeze can be tracked down. It only asks after you've played for a while, at most every half hour, and No stops it for the session.

### 0.1604.0

**Underground lakes in some caves**

Some lush caves deep inside the mountains were nearly dry. They now fill with proper underground lakes, deep in places, the way lush caves should. Only newly explored areas change.

### 0.1603.0

**High effect and enchantment levels show their number**

In the Dungeon Train modpacks, effect and enchantment levels above X now read properly. Tooltips, your effect list and a mob's details show the real level instead of dropping the number or printing a stray text key.

**Lush caves come alive**

Lush caves inside some of the mountains along the line were strangely empty. They now fill with axolotls, glow squid, fish, bats and the usual cave monsters, like lush caves anywhere else.

1.21.1.0.1532.0:
# Two Streams, Trial Vaults & Smarter Mobs

![Two Streams, Trial Vaults & Smarter Mobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/two-streams.jpg)

Three big additions ride the train at once.

**Two Streams** is a new Community Reward on the donations page. If one person donates, everyone gets it for a month! When active, a second player can go live without taking the Live Eye from whoever is already streaming. Right-click any TV to step it through off, Stream 1 and Stream 2. TV rooms come up showing a mix of both, and a TV worn on your head shows both streams, one above the other. Prefer just one? Click the TV in your inventory to pick, or set the default in Options / Dungeon Train / Stream. Each stream has its own Live chat too: watching both, pick Stream 1 or Stream 2 just above the chat box.

**Trial vaults.** Vaults now turn up on the train. Find a trial key to claim your own reward from each one.

**Smarter mobs.** Deeper down the line, in a place a good number of you reach, mobs reach for tools they previously ignored: a pickaxe, shovel or axe. Once they have seen you, a wall will not keep them out for long. The deeper you go, the more of them carry one and the smarter they get with them.

## Other significant updates

- Live streams adjust their quality to the streamer's upload speed, so viewers stop seeing them drop
- Live streams keep the streamer's real shape instead of looking stretched
- Hold a TV and right-click to switch it on or off
- Some of the players you meet on the train now turn up wearing a TV on their head
- Echoes no longer pick fights with piglin traders
- Fairer chat moderation that steps up gradually
- Smoother dimensional carriages, with less lag the further you go
- Leaving a dimensional carriage by a far exit puts you back in the right carriage
- A new story for the loading screen
- Bug fixes

Player Mobs climbing back onto the train no longer build their steps out of beds, doors, torches or chests, so you won't find half beds left beside the track. They now only use solid full blocks.

### 0.1496.0

**Consent screen switch labels translated**

The ON and OFF labels on the connect-to-the-internet card now show in your language instead of English. Chinese wording by 老本願.

### 0.1495.0

**The stream hears when a watcher falls**

Die while wearing a TV and watching someone's stream, and the stream's chat is told how it happened. Everyone in the room reads it, in their own language.

- Shows up in the stream's chat on Discord, Twitch, the website and in game

### 0.1487.0

**Smoother recovery from lag spikes**

After a sudden lag spike, the game no longer wakes up a long stretch of the train at once, so the hitch passes quicker instead of getting worse. Pausing and resuming still keeps your train safe.

**Echo fix**

Echoes of other players turn up more often again on quiet stretches of track.

**Better lag reports**

Short lag spikes now leave a clue in the game log, so the ones you report can be tracked down and fixed.
